title: Regularized coordinate minimization for nonconvex composite optimization with application to quantized image compression
summary: This paper presents a regularized cyclic coordinate minimization method for solving nonconvex composite optimization problems having the objective function formed as the sum of two terms, one is twice continuously differentiable and the second term is simple and separable. We analyze the convergence behaviour of our coordinate minimization method, in particular we provide convergence rates to a first-order optimality criterion and objective residual depending on the assumptions on the problem.
